title: Quantum Sphaera Companion: A Structure-First Mathematical Unfolding — full Companion and physics paper
description:
Quantum Sphaera Companion v5.2.0 is a minor version of the database-backed v5 release. As before, it comprises two complementary English documents from one source snapshot: the full Companion with its research history, and the physics paper Graded carriers and physical readouts: conditions for mass and geometric interpretation.

New in the full Companion are the research layers v4.10.0-r15 to r28. They record a correction of an earlier frame reading; status notes on the helicity axis, the invariant doublet, the clock functional, the commutant of one generation and prior literature; a candidate witness and a per-frame restatement of the open problem C5; a typing of the collapse state and of the cascade across the main body; a backward check of the counting statistics per frame; two and four Dixon copies and a duplication rule for the shift tower with a correction; and the status of the residual bend of the lepton phase and of the horizon counting rule after six refuted pre-registered tests and a series of explorations.

New in the physics paper: a short section on where the missing number of the bent-octant reading comes from. Symmetric constructions on the carrier fix the phase by their overlap, so the deficit cannot be obtained from the carrier; a flux-free core escapes this rigidity, but its size enters only through the horizon counting rule, whose weight two is chosen rather than derived. The conditional tau-mass value is therefore a joint test of the core reading, the counting rule and the form of the area spectrum.

Scope: this is a conditional mathematical-physics research programme, not a completed unified theory. No native lepton spectrum, absolute physical mass scale, general gravitational field equations or closure of the open problems is established by this release. The Koide overlap, the core size and the counting rule per frame remain open. Database registration, hashes and provenance checks do not constitute proof of physical interpretation. The manuscript has undergone documented self-review, not independent peer review.

The package contains two English PDFs, compilable sources, a database snapshot and checksum manifests. Both document editions retain open argument-review obligations.
